claims.evidence: One source per (cell line/SILAC channel, replicate mixture, material). TP = total proteome (24 bRPLC fractions, RT_SW48_KRAS_TP_RP0N_F01-F24), pY = anti-pY peptide IP (pY_IsogenicKRASmutants_RepN). PRIDE protocol: the pY IP used 60 mg of the mixed SILAC lysate digest per replicate and "a 600 ug aliquot of SILAC mix was also subjected to a separate in-solution tryptic digestion" for the total proteome, so TP and pY material of one replicate are separate aliquots/digests and get separate source names (precedent PXD020108), sharing the biological replicate number. The TP RP0N <-> RepN correspondence is the TP study factor Replicates; the pY study names its samples Rep1-Rep3.

claims.location: comment[label] rows 1-225 / characteristics[genotype], characteristics[cellosaurus accession], characteristics[cellosaurus name], factor value[genotype] rows 1-225
claims.value: SILAC light = SW48 parental (KRAS wild type); SILAC medium (Arg6/Lys4) = SW48 KRAS G12D/+; SILAC heavy (Arg10/Lys8) = SW48 KRAS G13D/+; same in all 3 TP and all 3 pY mixtures
claims.evidence: Primary (explicit) source: the authors' deposited TP Proteome Discoverer study (tp_msf) assigns factor Cells = Parental to the [Light], G12D to the [Medium] and G13D to the [Heavy] sample of every one of the 72 TP files (RP01-RP03 x F01-F24, 24 per replicate and channel), with factor Replicates = RepN for RP0N. The PD quan method fixes Medium = Arg6/Lys4 and Heavy = Arg10/Lys8. The pY PD study (py_msf AnalysisDefinition) defines no factors (only Light = SampleType Control in Rep1-3), so the pY runs (rows 217-225) take the map from the TP study through the PRIDE protocol statement that the TP sample is "a 600 ug aliquot of SILAC mix" whose remainder (60 mg per replicate) went to the pY IP; the TP orientation is identical in all three replicates, so it holds for every pY mixture. Data checks, all consistent: (1) mutant KRAS peptides in the TP search (database explicitly supplemented with KRAS G12D and G13D): G12D LVVVGADGVGK only with Lys4 (medium) - RP01 F21, RP02 F22, RP03 F21, RP03 F22 (4 PSMs); G13D LVVVGAGDVGK with Lys8 (heavy) in RP01 F22 and RP03 F22 (q <= 2.8e-6); the one light G13D PSM (RP03 F22 scan 14679, 1012.593 Da, 5.6 s after the heavy G13D PSM at scan 14625, 1020.608 Da; delta 8.014 Da = Lys8) is the unlabelled partner of the heavy G13D peptide, i.e. incomplete Lys8 incorporation in the G13D culture, not a map conflict; no G12D peptide outside medium, no G13D peptide in medium. (2) Light is SampleType Control in both PD studies and PRIDE computes "G12D/Parental ratios and G13D/Parental ratios". (3) pY: MPZL1 pY263 SESVVpYADIR log2 M/L +1.41/+1.30/+1.29 vs H/L -0.52/-0.68/-0.61 (file medians about -0.53 for both), and the abstract states MPZL1 "was found to be hyperphosphorylated in G12D cells".

claims.value: CVCL_1724 SW48 (light); CVCL_LC92 SW48 KRAS (G12D/+) (medium); CVCL_LC96 SW48 KRAS (G13D/+) (heavy)
claims.evidence: The TP PD study factor Cells (Parental / G12D / G13D, tp_msf) names the three lines per channel. PRIDE keywords "Sw48", "G12d mutation", "G13d mutation"; PRIDE description "isogenic colorectal cancer cell lines bearing either G12D or G13D KRAS mutation"; data protocol "G12D/Parental ... G13D/Parental". Cellosaurus lists exactly one SW48 KRAS G12D/+ (CVCL_LC92, Horizon HD 103-011) and one SW48 KRAS G13D/+ (CVCL_LC96, Horizon HD 103-002) knock-in among the children of CVCL_1724; the paper (closed) could not be read to confirm the supplier, see limitations.

claims.value: KRAS wild type; KRAS G12D/+; KRAS G13D/+
claims.evidence: Factor Cells in the TP PD study (tp_msf): Parental / G12D / G13D per channel. Custom characteristics column (spec Extending Templates; TERMS.tsv genotype = free text, EFO:0000513, licensed by single-cell/invertebrates/clinical-metadata only, none of which fit). Parental SW48 has no KRAS variant in Cellosaurus CVCL_1724 (only ACVR2A, APC, B2M, CTNNB1, TGFBR2 listed); derivatives are heterozygous knock-ins (Cellosaurus Zygosity=Heterozygous). The compared variable is the KRAS allele, so it is the factor.

TP PD study factor Replicates (Kind BiologicalReplicate) Rep1-Rep3 = RP01-RP03 (tp_msf); pY study samples pY_Isogenic KRAS mutants_Rep1-3. Three replicate SILAC mixtures (TP RP01-RP03; pY Rep1-Rep3; PRIDE: "the median values from the three replicates"); each mixture contains an independent culture per line, numbered 1..3 within each genotype group; the TP and pY aliquots of mixture N share number N.
PRIDE organisms NEWT:9606; SW48 is human (Cellosaurus OX NCBI_TaxID=9606).
Cellosaurus CVCL_1724 derived from site: In situ; Colon; UBERON_0001155. PRIDE organismPart "cell culture" is a dropdown, not tissue of origin.

Cellosaurus DI NCIt C4349 Colon adenocarcinoma for SW48 and both derivatives; MONDO:0002271 colon adenocarcinoma. PRIDE disease DOID:9256 colorectal cancer is the broader dropdown. All rows are cancer cell lines (no normal control arm).
All samples are cultured SILAC-labelled cell lines (PRIDE protocol "SILAC labeled cell pellets").

PRIDE protocol: "phosphotyrosine enrichment using phosphotyrosine rabbit monoclonal antibody kit (P-Tyr-1000; Cell Signaling Technology)". EFO:0010806 (closest EFO term under EFO:0009090; same term as campaign precedent PXD020108 pY runs). Rows 1-216 (total proteome) not applicable.
Cellosaurus Population: Caucasian (CVCL_1724, LC92, LC96); genome ancestry European North 69.25% + South 29.21%. HANCESTRO:0005.
Cellosaurus AG 83Y (live API, CVCL_1724 and both derivatives). The bundled sdrf-tools cellline DB says 82Y; the live record is used.
Cellosaurus SX Female.
Donor age 83Y (>= 20Y, batch rule 9); EFO:0001272 adult.
All three lines derive from the one SW48 donor (derivatives HI CVCL_1724 ! SW48).
EFO:0002367 SW48 (resolves in the validator). The isogenic derivatives have no EFO/CLO/BTO term; they are distinguished by cellosaurus accession/name and genotype.
One assay per raw file, shared by the three channels.

All 75 deposited .raw files: 72 TP (RP01-RP03 x F01-F24, the exact input list of the TP PD search) + 3 pY (Rep1-3, the exact input list of the pY msf WorkflowInputFiles). The .msf/.pep.xml/.prot.xml files are search output, not runs.
PRIDE: total proteome "fractionated by basic reversed phase liquid chromatography into 24 fractions"; pY single runs.
Each mixture/fraction injected once (no repeated injections in the file list).
Filled by sdrf-tools build from ms-proteomics.

limitations: Channel map provenance: the explicit source is the TP Proteome Discoverer study factor table (tp_msf), read from the 49.7 GB msf by HTTP-range SQLite by the independent reviewer; the producer re-tallied the reviewer's extracted AnalysisDefinition XML (sha256 1e053de8...c1) with its own parser but did not repeat the range read. The pY study has no factors; the pY runs inherit the map via the PRIDE same-mix statement, supported by the MPZL1 check. The paper itself (closed access; pubs.acs.org 403, not bypassed) was not read.

Pairing of TP mixture RP0N with pY mixture RepN: TP RP0N = RepN by the TP study factor Replicates, and the pY study names its samples Rep1-Rep3; that the two RepN labels denote the same mixture is the authors' naming, not separately stated. The pairing cannot change any label, because the TP orientation is the same in every replicate.
Cellosaurus accessions CVCL_LC92 / CVCL_LC96 assume the Horizon SW48 knock-in lines, the only SW48 KRAS G12D/+ and G13D/+ entries in Cellosaurus; the paper methods (supplier) could not be read.
Culture medium, passage number, storage temperature and cell type are not available (paper closed; PRIDE protocol silent).
Reduction/alkylation reagents are not stated (carbamidomethyl search implies alkylation, reagent unknown); columns omitted.

Search database differs from the PRIDE text: PD headers show human.RefSeq84 (TP: with KRAS G12D and G13D entries; pY: plain RefSeq84), PRIDE text says RefSeq v73 + mutant KRAS. Missed cleavages 2 in PD vs "one" in PRIDE text. SDRF follows the deposited search.
pY quantification in the paper used PyQuant on the PD identifications; the SDRF only describes the PD search.
MS1 scan range / collision energy read from 5 of 75 raw headers (same method file per run type).
reconcile organism_contradicted is a false positive (rabbit antibody); refuted in validation.txt.
